Class ElmCatalog.NodeKind

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmCatalog.NodeKind
Enclosing class:
ElmCatalog
public static final class ElmCatalog.NodeKind extends Object
A node kind of the catalog. Kinds refer to one another through their positions, so a kind is created first and its positions are filled once every kind exists.
